variants.name: Scarney
variants.special_mechanics:
As the bottom board cards are exposed, players discard matching ranks from their hands. Discards are placed face up on the second board. Failure to discard one or more cards as required voids the hand.
Pot # is lowest pip count with at least 1 card remaining. T-K = 10

variants.name: Scrotum

variants.name: SHESHE
variants.special_mechanics:
After individual cards are dealt, player separates cards into a 2-card
Hold’em hand and a 3-card Super Hold’em hand and caps them.

variants.name: 5-Card Shodugi

Hold’em hand and a 3-card Badugi hand. The 4th Badugi card will
be dealt before the draw.

variants.name: 6-Card Shodugi

variants.name: SOHE
variants.special_mechanics: SOHE Blinds * Split Pot * 7 Players Max C C C C C IIII SEPARATE INTO C C C C C II 2- & 4-CARD HANDS, CAP CARDS C C C C C 6 DOWN Bet Bet Bet Bet After individual cards are dealt, player separates cards into a 2-card Hold’em hand and a 4-card Omaha hand. Once the hands are set, changing them will foul the player’s hand.

variants.name: Crazy SOHE
variants.special_mechanics: Crazy SOHE Blinds * Split Pot * 7 Players Max C C C C C IIII C C C SEPARATE INTO C C II 2- & 4-CARD HANDS, CAP CARDS C C C C C 6 DOWN Bet Bet Bet Bet Prior to the turn, player separates cards into a 2-card Hold’em hand and a 4-card Omaha hand. Changing the hand after the turn has been exposed will foul the player’s hand.

variants.name: Lazy SOHE
variants.special_mechanics: Lazy SOHE Blinds * Split Pot * 7 Players Max C C C C C IIII C C C C C SEPARATE INTO II 2- & 4-CARD HANDS, CAP CARDS C C C C C 6 DOWN Bet Bet Bet Bet After the river betting, player separates cards into a 2-card Hold’em hand and a 4-card Omaha hand. Changing the hand once showdown begins will foul the player’s hand.
